Tests that LLM max_concurrency is accepted independently of the extraction thread budget

```elixir title="Elixir"
input_value = %Xberg.ExtractInput{kind: "uri", mime_type: "text/plain", uri: "https://example.com/text/report.txt"}
result = Xberg.extract_async(input_value, "{\"captioning\":{\"llm\":{\"max_concurrency\":2,\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o\"},\"min_image_area\":1000},\"concurrency\":{\"max_threads\":8}}")
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).mime_type)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).content)
```
